title: Bitcoin $100K mainstream five-card selection
selectionBasis: Freeze on accessible, source-backed, non-circular facts with varied mechanisms and spacing before fresh event-response calculation.

inclusionReasons.hong-kong-etfs: Recognizable access/product milestone; HKEX is the primary exchange record and the event broadens the story beyond U.S. policy.
inclusionReasons.mtgox-repayments: Concrete supply/liquidity development with an official trustee notice; provides a negative-side mechanism rather than five bullish cards.
inclusionReasons.fed-50-cut: Mainstream macro catalyst with an exact Federal Reserve release time and a distinct financial-conditions mechanism.
inclusionReasons.trump-election: Highly accessible political result with an AP race-call time and a policy-expectations mechanism.
inclusionReasons.microstrategy-purchase: Mainstream corporate-adoption fact from an SEC filing; tests whether disclosed treasury demand is distinct from the election narrative.

exclusions.ether-etf-approval: Removed to avoid a specialist-heavy pair of ETF/regulatory cards; it is retained in the original eight-event study.
exclusions.ibit-options: Removed because it is a second specialist market-structure/regulatory card and overlaps the Fed event window.
exclusions.gensler-departure: Removed for this mainstream five because the later regulatory-transition story is narrower than the selected macro, political, supply, access, and corporate mix.
exclusions.threshold-crossing: Never an event card: the contract's own underlying BTC-USD threshold crossing is circular with the target outcome and is reserved for the reveal-only ending.

priorExposure: The existing eight-event Bitcoin study, broad pre-ending screen, raw/normalized probability history, and prior draft measurements were visible in the repository before this freeze. This is not a blinded preregistration. No new event-response calculation was used to choose these five.
measurementPlan: After this freeze, calculate only with the retained Polymarket YES probability series, MONTHS_PROFILE, existing calculateStudyImpacts implementation, and pairwise-anchor-1pt-v1 tie rule. No spot-price substitution, interpolation, carried prices, contract splice, or score-driven replacement.
